translation.title: Flurbiprofen Adhesive Patch
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for pain relief and anti-inflammation in degenerative arthritis (osteoarthritis), periarthritis of the shoulder, tendinitis and tenosynovitis, peritendinitis, epicondylitis of the humerus, muscle pain, and post-traumatic swelling and pain.
translation.usage: Remove the release liner from the adhesive side and apply the patch to the affected area twice a day. Wipe off sweat from the application site before use.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, or if you have experienced asthma when using aspirin or non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have bronchial asthma, or if you are pregnant, a child, or elderly. Do not use it on damaged skin or mucous membranes, or on areas with eczema or rash. Wipe off sweat from the application site before use. Adverse reactions may occur - sometimes redness, rash, drug eruption, itching and burning sensation, contact dermatitis, or asthma attacks (dry crackles, wheezing, difficulty breathing, etc.); if any of these occur, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature away from light, and keep out of reach of children.
